description: Curated, source-backed CFD terminology mappings. Names are scoped by software, role, applicability, and caveats; they are not global string aliases.

concepts.label: Static pressure
concepts.definition: Thermodynamic static pressure of the moving fluid. Keep gauge representation, absolute reference, and solver-specific pressure scaling explicit.

aliases.name: Pressure
aliases.applicability: CGNS/SIDS static flowfield pressure; inspect DataClass and unit metadata before interpreting stored numbers.
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; the file may store dimensional or normalized values.

aliases.name: p
aliases.applicability: Compressible solvers that store dimensional static pressure.
aliases.caveat: The same spelling p is kinematic pressure in common incompressible solvers; inspect solver and field dimensions.

aliases.name: Static Pressure
aliases.caveat: Fluent Static Pressure is gauge pressure relative to Operating Pressure, not absolute pressure.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_PRESSURE
aliases.caveat: A freestream boundary/reference parameter, not a local solution field.

concepts.label: Kinematic pressure
concepts.definition: Pressure divided by density, commonly used by constant-density incompressible formulations.

aliases.name: p
aliases.applicability: Common incompressible solvers such as icoFoam/simpleFoam.
aliases.caveat: Do not compare directly with dimensional pressure in Pa; convert with the applicable reference/local density as documented by the solver.

concepts.label: Absolute pressure
concepts.definition: Static pressure referenced to vacuum; in Fluent it is operating pressure plus gauge static pressure.

aliases.name: Absolute Pressure
aliases.caveat: Fluent defines this as Operating Pressure plus gauge pressure.

concepts.label: Total (stagnation) pressure
concepts.definition: Pressure at the stagnation state obtained by bringing the flow isentropically to rest; exact evaluation depends on thermodynamic model and frame.

aliases.name: PressureStagnation
aliases.caveat: CGNS uses stagnation naming; rotating-frame variants are separate identifiers.

aliases.name: Total Pressure
aliases.caveat: Definition depends on compressible/incompressible model and frame; distinguish relative/stationary-frame variants.

aliases.name: total(p)
aliases.applicability: Output of the pressure function object.
aliases.caveat: Derived output, not necessarily a solver's primary stored field; pressure function-object options and reference pressure matter.

concepts.label: Static density
concepts.definition: Mass per unit volume of the fluid at the local thermodynamic state.

aliases.name: Density
aliases.caveat: CGNS file DataClass and units determine how stored values are represented.

aliases.name: rho
aliases.caveat: Some incompressible solvers use constant/reference density without a local rho field.

aliases.name: Density
aliases.applicability: Fluent fluid cell-zone variable; phase selection matters in multiphase cases.
aliases.caveat: Fluent describes this as mass per unit volume; multiphase selection may scope the value to a phase.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_DENSITY
aliases.caveat: This is a freestream input parameter, not a local density field.

concepts.label: Velocity vector
concepts.definition: Fluid velocity vector. Components and magnitude are distinct scalar quantities; coordinate frame and grid location must be retained.

aliases.name: VelocityX / VelocityY / VelocityZ
aliases.applicability: Cartesian inertial-frame components by default; use rotating identifiers for rotating-frame quantities.
aliases.caveat: CGNS stores vector quantities as scalar component arrays; rotating-frame components are not interchangeable.

aliases.name: U
aliases.caveat: Field type and location (for example volVectorField) depend on solver and mesh representation.

aliases.name: Velocity; X Velocity; Y Velocity; Z Velocity
aliases.applicability: Velocity magnitude or components; availability depends on dimension and model.
aliases.caveat: Relative, axial, radial, tangential, and mesh velocities are distinct quantities.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_VELOCITY
aliases.caveat: A freestream input parameter, not the local solution velocity field.

concepts.label: Mesh coordinates
concepts.definition: Physical coordinates of mesh vertices or points. Coordinate system, units, and reference frame are part of the meaning.

aliases.name: CoordinateX / CoordinateY / CoordinateZ
aliases.applicability: Cartesian coordinates; cylindrical and auxiliary coordinate identifiers are separate.
aliases.caveat: Coordinates are dimensional or normalized according to CGNS metadata.

aliases.name: points
aliases.applicability: Mesh point positions in the polyMesh geometry.
aliases.caveat: This names mesh geometry, not a flow-solution field.

aliases.name: X Coordinate; Y Coordinate; Z Coordinate
aliases.caveat: Coordinate components depend on spatial dimension.
